title: An semidefinite programming-based $\varepsilon$-constraint method for the bi-objective single-row facility layout problem
summary: In this work, we introduce a multi-objective version of the well-known single-row facility layout problem (SRFLP). In the SRFLP, a set of one-dimensional facilities should be placed along a single line such that the weighted sum of the center-to-center distances of each pair of facilities is minimized. In our multi-objective extension, there are multiple such weighted-sum objectives which we consider under the concept of Pareto optimality.
